name: Irbesartan
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.action: Contraindicated in diabetes; avoid if GFR below 60 mL/min.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: ACE inhibitors, other ARBs (dual RAS blockade)
key_interactions.effect: More hypotension, hyperkalemia and acute kidney failure, usually without added benefit (label).
key_interactions.action: In general avoid; if used, closely monitor blood pressure, kidney function and electrolytes.

key_interactions.effect: Worse kidney function, possible acute kidney failure in older, volume-depleted or CKD patients; weaker antihypertensive effect (label).
